ghs.name: Hidden in the Shadows
top: "If the attack ability killed an enemy, perform:" {Invisible [diamond] {target: self}}
bottom: "If you have not moved this round, perform:" {Invisible {target: self}}
("You cannot perform move abilities this round. At the end of the round, lose Invisible.")

xipe.data:
Data:
    Top:
        Abilities:
            TActive:
                AddActiveBonus:
                    Invisible: True
                    Filter: Self
                    AnimOverload: TurnInvisible
                ActiveBonus:
                    Duration: Ability
                    Behaviour: DuringActionAbilityOnKill
                    Requirement: 
                        OnYourTurn: True
                    Filter: Enemy 
                AutoTrigger: True #Check
            TAttack:
                Attack:
                    Amount: 3
                    Enhancements: 1
                AttackHasAdvantage: True
     
    Bottom:
        Abilities:
            BInvis:
                Invisible: 
                    DecrementTrigger: Rounds
                Filter: Self
                AnimOverload: TurnInvisible
                StartAbilityRequirements:
                    Type: ThisAbility
                    HexesMovedThisTurn: "<= 0"
            BAbilityOverrideAbilityType:
                AddActiveBonus:
                    Attack: 0
                #PreviewEffectText: "<sprite name=Move> / <sprite name=Attack>"
                ActiveBonus:
                    Behaviour: OverrideMoveAbility
                    Duration: Round
                    ValidAbilityType: Move
                    #IsToggleBonus: True
                    ActiveBonusAbilityOverrides:
                        BCTypeOverride:
                            AbilityType: Heal #Null throws exception
                            Strength: 0
                            Filter:
                                ActorType: Summon
                                TargetType: Ally
                                HeroSummonClasses: [NullID]
